meta.title: MiroFish - Predict Everything
meta.description: MiroFish - Social Media Opinion Simulation System

home.heroDesc: From a single document, {brand} extracts reality seeds to auto-generate a parallel world with up to {agentScale}. Inject variables from a god's-eye view to find the {optimalSolution} in complex group dynamics.
home.slogan: Let Agents rehearse the future, let decisions prevail
home.systemReadyDesc: Prediction engine on standby. Upload unstructured data to initialize a simulation sequence.
home.step01Desc: Seed extraction & memory injection & GraphRAG construction
home.step02Desc: Entity extraction & persona generation & Agent config injection
home.step03Desc: Dual-platform parallel sim & auto-parse requirements & temporal memory
home.step04Desc: ReportAgent interacts with the post-simulation environment via rich tools
home.step05Desc: Chat with any simulated individual & converse with ReportAgent
home.promptPlaceholder: // Describe your simulation or prediction requirement in natural language

step1.ontologyDesc: LLM analyzes document content and simulation requirements, extracts reality seeds, and auto-generates a suitable ontology structure
step1.graphRagDesc: Based on the generated ontology, documents are auto-chunked and sent to Zep to build a knowledge graph, extracting entities and relations, forming temporal memory and community summaries
step1.buildCompleteDesc: Graph build is complete. Proceed to the next step for simulation environment setup.

step2.simInstanceDesc: Create a new simulation instance and pull world parameter templates
step2.generateAgentPersonaDesc: Combine context to auto-extract entities and relations from the knowledge graph, initialize simulated individuals, and assign unique behaviors and memories based on reality seeds
step2.dualPlatformConfigDesc: LLM intelligently sets world time flow, recommendation algorithms, each individual's active hours, posting frequency, event triggers, and more based on requirements and reality seeds
step2.initialActivationDesc: Auto-generate initial activation events and hot topics based on narrative direction to guide the simulation world's initial state
step2.setupCompleteDesc: Simulation environment is ready. You can now start the simulation.
step2.roundsConfigDesc: MiroFish auto-plans to simulate {hours} real-world hours, each round representing {minutesPerRound} minutes of elapsed time
step2.customTip: For first-time runs, we strongly recommend switching to 'Custom Mode' to reduce rounds for a quick preview and lower error risk
step2.personaDimExperienceDesc: Complete behavioral trajectory in this event

step3.oldSimCleared: Old simulation logs cleared, restarting simulation
step3.preparingGoBack: Preparing to return to Step 2, closing simulation...
step3.closeFailed: Failed to close simulation environment, attempting force stop...

step4.panelKeyFacts: Latest key facts from temporal memory

step5.chatWithAgent: Chat with any individual in the world
step5.reportAgentDesc: A conversational version of the report generation agent with access to 4 professional tools and MiroFish's complete memory
step5.toolInsightForgeDesc: Aligns real-world seed data with simulation state, combining Global/Local Memory for cross-temporal deep attribution analysis
step5.toolPanoramaSearchDesc: Graph-based BFS algorithm that reconstructs event propagation paths, capturing the full topology of information flow
step5.toolQuickSearchDesc: GraphRAG-based instant query interface with optimized indexing for fast extraction of node attributes and discrete facts
step5.toolInterviewSubAgentDesc: Autonomous interviews that conduct parallel multi-round dialogues with simulated individuals, collecting unstructured opinion data and psychological states
step5.chatEmptyReportAgent: Chat with Report Agent to explore report content in depth
step5.chatEmptyAgent: Chat with simulated individuals to understand their perspectives
step5.surveyInputPlaceholder: Enter the question you want to ask all selected targets...
step5.selectAgentFirst: Please select a simulated individual first

comparison.title: Compare saved simulations
comparison.scope: Compare the latest saved run for two different simulation IDs. Restarting a simulation replaces its saved run; previous attempts are not archived here.
comparison.choiceScope: Latest saved run · saved status and update time shown in each choice
comparison.missingSelection: {id} is not in the saved list. It may have been deleted or could not be read. Choose another simulation or refresh.
comparison.noCandidates: No saved simulations are available. Save two different simulations before comparing.
comparison.skippedRecords: {count} unreadable saved records were omitted from the list.
comparison.invalidSelection: The URL contains an invalid selection. Choose one simulation on each side.
comparison.choosePair: Choose two saved simulations to see their recorded activity.
comparison.interpretation: These are recorded action attempts, including failed attempts. They do not measure successful interactions, completed rounds, causal effects, model quality or prediction accuracy.
comparison.unavailableNote: An em dash means unavailable, not zero. Partial counts include only readable, valid observations.
comparison.modelNote: The configured model is saved metadata; it does not establish which model actually ran.
comparison.differenceNote: Every difference is right minus left. A difference is available only when both relevant sources are complete.
comparison.metricsCaption: Counts from the selected saved action logs
comparison.agentNote: Active agents are distinct IDs within each platform. Agent IDs are unrelated between simulations.
comparison.actionTypesCaption: Union of recorded action types; an absent type is zero only when that side has complete observations.
comparison.noActionTypes: No action types are available in the selected observations.

errors.candidates: The saved simulation list could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
errors.generic: The comparison could not be loaded. Try Compare again.
errors.invalid_selection: Choose two different, valid simulation IDs.
errors.unsafe_path: A selected saved record cannot be safely read. Choose another simulation.
errors.simulation_not_found: A selected simulation no longer exists. Choose another simulation or refresh.
errors.simulation_unreadable: A selected simulation record could not be read. Choose another simulation or try again.
errors.simulation_active: A selected saved run is marked active. Wait until it has stopped, then try Compare again.
errors.sources_changed: The saved files changed while they were being read. Please try again.

warnings.config_unavailable: Saved configuration is unavailable; some context is missing.
warnings.run_state_unavailable: Saved run state is unavailable; status uses the saved simulation state.
warnings.run_not_terminal: The saved state does not establish a finished run. Observations are unavailable.
warnings.partial_run: This run stopped or failed; recorded activity may cover only part of the requested run.
warnings.platform_log_missing: The configured platform has no readable saved log.
warnings.platform_not_configured: A saved log exists for a platform absent from the saved configuration.
warnings.invalid_records: {count} invalid records were skipped. Observed counts are partial.
warnings.source_unreadable: A saved action source could not be read.
warnings.source_too_large: A saved action source exceeds the supported reading limits. Its observations are unavailable.
warnings.no_action_logs: No saved action logs are available.
warnings.generic: Some saved data could not be fully verified.

savedActivity.title: Saved activity
savedActivity.scope: Explore the latest saved run for this simulation ID. Restarting replaces its saved files; previous attempts are not archived here.
savedActivity.filterNote: Filters match exactly. Agent and round IDs are nonnegative whole numbers; zero is valid. Apply changes to read a page.
savedActivity.orderNote: Saved source/file order: Twitter then Reddit, each in forward file order; legacy combined files keep their own file order. This is not a merged timestamp timeline.
savedActivity.attemptNote: Each row is a recorded attempt, including failed and unknown outcomes. Identical attempts remain separate.
savedActivity.draftNote: Filters have changed. Apply filters to read matching activity; the previous page is no longer displayed.
savedActivity.statusNote: Saved status describes the files observed, not verified ownership of a live process.
savedActivity.partialNote: Partial counts cover only readable, valid observations. An em dash means unavailable, not zero. Downloads contain only this displayed page.
savedActivity.tableCaption: Saved action attempts in source/file order
savedActivity.unavailable: Saved observations are unavailable for this selection. Refresh when saved files are available.
savedActivity.noMatches: No matching recorded attempts in the readable saved sources.
savedActivity.outOfRange: This page is beyond the matching recorded attempts. Return to the first page.

errors.generic: Saved activity could not be loaded. Apply filters or Refresh to try again.
errors.invalid_selection: The URL contains an invalid saved selection. Use one simulation ID and one value for each supported filter.
errors.invalid_filters: Enter a supported platform, up to 64 decimal digits for agent and round IDs, and a nonblank action type up to 256 characters without control or line-break characters.
errors.invalid_pagination: Use a page size from 1 to 100 and an offset from 0 to 500000. Apply filters to start at the first page.
errors.invalid_revision: The saved revision in this URL is invalid. Refresh to read the latest saved files.
errors.revision_required: This page needs its saved revision. Refresh to start from the first page.
errors.unsafe_path: This saved record cannot be safely read. Return to history and choose another simulation.
errors.simulation_not_found: This saved simulation no longer exists. Return to history and choose another simulation.
errors.simulation_unreadable: This saved simulation record could not be read. Refresh to try again.
errors.simulation_active: The saved run is marked active. Wait until it has stopped, then Refresh.
errors.sources_changed: The saved files changed. Refresh to read the latest files from the first page.
errors.response_too_large: This page is too large to return safely. Choose a smaller page size, including 1, then Apply filters.
